name: discord-social-preview-bot
description: A lightweight Discord bot that previews Meta Threads, X/Twitter, and other supported links using FixEmbed.

scripts.start: if [ -x /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node ]; then /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node src/index.js; else node src/index.js; fi
scripts.test: npm run test:pure && npm run test:routing && npm run test:circuit
